scenario_description:
Objective: Use an optional peer comparison at the planned hobby demo to learn which oxidation finish matches Theo’s existing Rustwisp drones.
Emerging Need: A visiting painter’s two reference pieces become available to compare in person only after the shared table schedule is posted.
Decision Context: Theo’s saved acrylic recipe and matte finish distinguish the relevant comparison from an oil/enamel display. The comparison overlaps his casual demo slot, so he can move that informal slot without losing access.
Consequence: Joining the short comparison could improve future repair matching; missing it leaves ordinary demo attendance unchanged, and no custom item or prize is being claimed.

parameter.title: Isthmus Open Hobby Demo Night
parameter.description: Open tables for casual painting, skirmish chatter, and a possible visiting pigment-vendor sample station if their weekend equipment test works.

parameter.subject: Monday demo night vendor extras still tentative
parameter.body: Monday may include a visiting painter’s finish-comparison table. There is no sign-up or giveaway; we do not yet know whether the pieces are acrylic or enamel or when the painter will be present.

parameter.content: The visitor confirmed water-based acrylic weathering pieces. Table times still depend on Monday’s travel arrival; the casual skirmish demo can run in either the early or late slot.

parameter.subject: Monday finish comparison scheduled: matte acrylic metal
parameter.body: The visiting painter will compare two matte water-based acrylic oxidation finishes at 18:10–18:30 Monday, then pack both pieces for travel. Theo’s casual demo slot is currently 18:00–18:30; it can move to 18:40 at no charge by replying to this inbox before 16:00 today. Bring only your own recipe notes if useful. No giveaway, purchase, or formal lesson is involved.

parameter.content: The visitor has finished the two-piece finish comparison and left with the reference models. The normal hobby room and late casual demo are still open, but there will be no repeat comparison tonight.
